_comment: Pinned jellyfin-web build served by the E2E mock server at /web/.
jellyfin-web's own GitHub releases carry no built assets, so the build is
taken from the Jellyfin server's Debian package, which is the smallest
published archive that contains a compiled web client (~32 MB against the
~168 MB Windows server zip). The package is architecture-independent
(_all.deb); the +deb12 flavour is picked arbitrarily among the three.
Astrofin's device profile is written against Jellyfin 10.11 (see
src/jellyfin/src/lib.rs), so the web client is pinned to the same line.
To bump: change version/url, run `node dev/e2e/setup.mjs --print-sha256`
